title: Unkept promises and poor follow-up
summary: The topic centers on dealer or salesperson promises, with examples about missed callbacks, delayed sending of items, and guidance that felt more promised than delivered.

negative.summary: The negative review describes an uninterested supplying dealer who failed to return a promised call.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention promises being withdrawn, repeated assurances that something would be sent without arrival, and a need for better buyer guidance, but the excerpts alone are insufficient to fix a clear sentiment label.

limitations: The sample is very small, and most excerpts are labeled undetermined, limiting confidence in a more specific thematic or sentiment interpretation.
The topic clusters related but somewhat different issues, including dealer follow-up, sending promised items, and general buyer guidance.
